system.name: Cur-MGAE
system.one_liner: A masked graph autoencoder that scores edges by reconstruction difficulty and masks them from easy to hard on a self-paced schedule.

content.variant_note: three tinted regions (scheduler, curriculum masking, masked autoencoder) linked by redrawings of the same five-node toy graph at every step
content.argues: Masking edges by a learned difficulty score, easy first and then harder as training proceeds, gives the graph autoencoder a better pretext task than random masking.
content.subject: One toy graph passing through the mask scheduler, the curriculum masking module and the structure-aware masked autoencoder.

elements.name: Scheduler
elements.role: orders the curriculum from Easy to Hard while the schedule parameters increase
elements.drawn_as: thick black ruler arrow with five ticks, labelled Easy, Hard and the symbols for increasing

elements.name: five scheduler snapshots
elements.role: the edge set at successive stages: more and more edges become solid red
elements.drawn_as: five dashed rounded boxes in a row with the toy graph, joined by thin arrows

elements.name: Input Graph (A)
elements.drawn_as: dashed box with the toy graph in black solid edges and blue nodes

elements.name: Residual Graph (R = A - A_re)
elements.role: per-edge reconstruction residual used as the difficulty score
elements.drawn_as: same graph with a number between 0.1 and 0.9 printed on each edge

elements.name: Curriculum Edge Set (A^(t))
elements.role: the edges chosen for the current training stage
elements.drawn_as: same graph with chosen edges in solid red and the rest dashed black

elements.name: mask ratio upper-bound
elements.role: limits how many edges may be masked

elements.name: split ratio
elements.role: divides the mask budget between the two selection routes
elements.drawn_as: blue rounded box with arrows up and down

elements.name: 1 Difficulty-based Edge Selection
elements.role: picks edges by difficulty: the curriculum set A^(t) becomes A_DES
elements.drawn_as: pink rounded box with two toy graphs and an arrow between them

elements.name: 2 Random-based Edge Selection
elements.role: picks random edges from the remaining ones: A - A_DES becomes A_RES
elements.drawn_as: grey-lavender rounded box with two toy graphs and an arrow between them

elements.name: Masked Edge Set (A_mask = A_DES + A_RES)
elements.role: the union of both selections, the edges to hide
elements.drawn_as: dashed box with the toy graph in gold edges

elements.name: Input (A~ = A - A_mask)
elements.role: the graph with masked edges removed, fed to the autoencoder
elements.drawn_as: dashed box with orange solid edges and black dashed masked edges

elements.name: First Layer ... Last Layer
elements.role: GNN encoder layers producing node embeddings
elements.drawn_as: two dashed boxes (orange then blue nodes) with small three-cell embedding stacks, separated by an ellipsis

elements.name: Cross-correlation decoder
elements.role: turns node embeddings into edge predictions; includes an MLP
elements.drawn_as: dashed box with purple, blue and orange embedding stacks, crossing lines and a grey MLP box

elements.name: Reconstructed Graph (A_re)
elements.role: the predicted graph, with the predicted edges in purple
elements.drawn_as: dashed box with salmon nodes, orange and purple edges and a purple Predict label

elements.name: Reconstruction Loss
elements.role: compares the reconstructed graph with the input graph
elements.drawn_as: grey dashed double-headed arrow at the left edge with a grey label

lessons.what_to_learn: Follow one toy graph through every stage, redrawing it at the same position and changing only the edge styling (solid, dashed, coloured) with a score or set name printed underneath, so each module's effect on the data is visible; add an Easy-to-Hard ruler above a row of snapshots to show a curriculum.
lessons.suits: Graph or structure-learning methods (masking, sampling, pruning, curriculum) where each module edits a set of edges or nodes of the same small graph.

evidence: a structure-aware masked autoencoder, a complexity-guided curriculum masking module, and a self-paced mask scheduler
each edge is assigned a difficulty score based on its reconstruction residual error
we design a self-paced mask scheduler to dynamically schedule the masking curriculum according to the training stage

summary: Cur-MGAE is a masked graph autoencoder that masks edges from easy to hard. Figure 1 follows one five-node toy graph through three tinted regions. In the lavender Self-paced Mask Scheduler, an Easy-to-Hard ruler sits above five snapshots with more and more solid edges, while the input graph becomes a residual graph with printed edge difficulty scores and then a sorted curriculum edge set. In the peach Complexity-guided Curriculum Masking, a mask-ratio upper bound and a split ratio feed difficulty-based and random-based edge selection, whose union is the masked edge set. In the green Structure-aware Masked Autoencoder, the masked graph passes the first layer, the last layer and a cross-correlation decoder to the reconstructed graph, tied back to the input by a dashed reconstruction-loss arrow.
